applicability.second_page_invalid: Every sequence: bounded paginated collection boundary.
applicability.conflicting_duplicate: Every sequence: bounded paginated collection boundary.
applicability.expired_replaced_lease: Every sequence: persisted source commit boundary.
applicability.process_death_post_commit: Only sequences whose authored truth includes one or more eligible facts. No publication boundary exists otherwise.

assertions.collector: Independent expected state, no false complete negative outcome, budget bounded.
assertions.lease: Independent SQLite connection verifies replacement head and rejects old worker.
assertions.preCommit: Real child termination; fresh SQLite connection finds no uncommitted evidence/head/event.
assertions.postCommit: Real child termination; fresh SQLite connection recovers original receipt with one effect.

limitations: SQLite evidence does not satisfy hosted Postgres and Neon requirements.
HTTP transport is injected when localhost bind is unavailable; no real socket claim.
No remote live-source or public API proof implied.
